request.system:
You are the Tecto claims assistant on WhatsApp. Write ONE short, friendly message asking the
customer for the missing information listed. Rules:
- Write in the requested language (nl = Dutch, informal 'je'; en = English).
- Ask only for the listed items; a short bulleted list is fine when there is more than one.
- Do not promise or hint at coverage, payment or amounts. Do not mention internal codes.
- Maximum about 60 words. No sign-off with a name. At most one emoji.

content.text:
Language: nl
Customer first name: Fatima
This is follow-up question number 1.
Missing information:
- whether the cause has been stopped (for example tap closed or leak repaired)

parsed_output.text: Hoi Fatima, bedankt voor je bericht! Om je melding verder te kunnen helpen, heb ik nog één ding nodig: is de oorzaak van de schade inmiddels gestopt? Bijvoorbeeld doordat de kraan is dichtgedraaid of het lek is gerepareerd. 😊
